title: Overbright asset format: a car unit (ob.car-unit)
description: cars.md 3.7. cars/<NAME>/unit.toml: what one CARS/<NAME>/ folder (or cars/common/) holds and what it is for.

name.description: The unit name = the original folder name (or common).

role.description: car: a car type's own folder; part-group: a shared part group; wheels: the rims by brand; common: the files all cars share; unreferenced: a folder nothing loads.

loaded_with.description: role part-group / wheels: who loads it in the original (informational; the engine's own list decides, engine-tables.md).

file.description: The original folder's files, in name order.

original.description: The file's name in the original folder, original spelling.

state.description: data: has content; empty: a zero-length file (the engine opens it and finds nothing).

paths.description: The logical paths (relative to the unit) of the top-level files the owning page writes for it (e.g. meshes/GEOMETRY.BIN.0.gltf, textures/TEXTURES.toml, anim/PARTS_ANIMATIONS.bin.banks.toml); absent for an empty file and for a file whose kind is still at stage 0 in the unit (import.md 4.1).
